data: How many models are used to compare AUC and Logloss based on number of neurons?

To determine how many models are used, I will count the distinct lines in each graph:

1. In the AUC graph, there are 7 distinct lines.
2. In the Logloss graph, there are also 7 distinct lines.

Since both graphs contain the same set of models, the total number of models used is 7.
